pages.text: Successfully feed a Burrel a Pinecone and a Glaceros the Larkspur matching its antler variant.

pages.title: Guests from the Cold
pages.text: Pinecones support further Burrel visits and displays give found antlers a place at home.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Find them in Frostbite Forest. Burrel likes Pinecones and sap. Glaceros antler variants prefer corresponding Larkspur flowers; one color is not universal.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Travel to the Frostbite Forest and gather its cedar and cold-biome plants. A distinct Ice Age themed habitat provides local resources and wildlife.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Offer pinecones to a Burrel found in the cold forest. The author identifies pinecones as its favored food; taming is not established.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Feed a Burrel Pinecones or offer sap. The climbing forest critter favors these foods; the installed advancement explicitly recognizes Pinecone feeding.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Match a Glaceros antler variant with its preferred Larkspur. The skittish herd animal has variant-specific flower preferences and supplies venison when hunted.
